_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mu kwingila Golf (Kadi ya Mwiza) - Mwina {player_id}.
Kazwiti: Funa kufika na madotha madikidi ya chini kabisa mu mpindi uyu. Ikiwa safu zina thamani ile ile, zinaongezwa kama 0.
Thamani za Kadi: A=1, 2-10=thamani ya uso, J/Q=10, K=0

Makhuwiro (tumia mabano ya kuunga):
- '[draw]' - Tokota kadi kutoka kwenye sitaha
- '[take]' - Tokota kadi kutoka kwenye sitaha ya kadi zilizotupwa
- '[swap X Y]' - Badilisha kadi iliyotokotwa na nafasi X (safu) Y (safu wima)
- '[discard]' - Tupwa kadi iliyotokotwa

board.drew:
Wakutokota: {card}
Sasa unahitaji [swap X Y] au [discard] kadi.
board.took:
Wakutokota: {card} kutoka kwenye sitaha ya kadi zilizotupwa
Unahitaji [swap X Y] nayo (hauwezi kutupwa).

options.final_turns: Mipindi ya mwisho! Makhuwiro yako: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Unahitaji: [swap X Y] (hauwezi kutupwa kadi kutoka kwenye sitaha ya kadi zilizotupwa)

message.deck_empty: Kipungu cha kadi kisina kitu! Mweso unakomesha sasa.
message.knocked: Mwina {pid} aligonga! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata mpindi mmoja zaidi.
message.final_round: Mwina {pid} {reason}! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata mpindi mmoja zaidi.

invalid.wrong_action: Tumia mabano ya kuunga moja tu: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Unasi ku ghula kadi e ithwale mu bwire. U fanele ku yi thala.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Una kadi iliyotokotwa. Unahitaji [swap X Y] au [discard] kadi.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Ukosefu wa kadi ya kuteka kubadilisha.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Nafasi haiko ndani ya mipaka. Tumia safu 1-{max_row}, safu wima 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Cj, uwezi ku ghula na kadi ya benye. Ghala mupira wako wa kwanza.
invalid.already_knocked: Muntu mukwabo tayari akubwinya mweso uyu.
